High Resistance Grounding Systems

HRGS

Protects the plant's entire electrical grid from catastrophic ground faults.

Request a Quote

Öz Direnç HRGS uses resistors to protect the plant's entire electrical grid from catastrophic ground faults.

The Öz Direnç High Resistance Grounding System (HRGS) is used in continuous-process industrial plants where a sudden electrical shutdown would cause massive financial losses, unsafe conditions, or damaged product.

It is installed in electrical substations between the neutral point of a transformer (or generator) and the earth ground.

Industries served

  • Data centers & server facilities
  • Oil, gas & petrochemical refineries
  • Semiconductor & microchip manufacturing
  • Pulp, paper & textile mills
  • Food & beverage processing plants
  • Hospital & healthcare critical grids
